subject: Onsite workshop: asset grooming, presenter ownership & travel ops
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@orchardhealth.com>, Jeff Ortiz <jeff@venueops.co>
Cc: procurement@orchardhealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite workshop: asset grooming, presenter ownership & travel ops

Hi all —

We’re greenlit for the Orchard Health executive workshop in NYC (Aug 24–25). This thread is to lock ownership for slides / pre-reads and call out travel ops so nothing is left until the last minute. Quick summary and asks below.

What we have:
- Venue: Midtown conference room (capacity 60) — floor plan attached.
- Attendees: Orchard execs + product/infra (final list coming from Sarah).
- Workshop goals: align on inference roadmap, run a technical deep-dive, and surface migration plan for Dedicated deployments.

What I need from the Red team by EOD Tue Aug 12:
1) Slide owner confirmations: list how many slides you will own and whether you need an appendix for technical notes.
2) AV / demo needs: laptops, live GPU demo (yes/no), network requirements.
3) Travel constraints: any hard blackout dates or travel-merge needs (e.g., prefer to arrive night of 23rd).
4) Pre-read: I will compile a single pre-read PDF. Please upload a one-page summary + any appendices to the shared deck link by Mon Aug 17.

Attachments: draft-runbook-v1.pdf (run-of-show draft), pre-read-outline.docx, venue-floorplan.png.
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-deck (master deck & upload folder)

Basic timeline:
- Aug 12: presenter confirmations + travel constraints in this thread.
- Aug 17: pre-read bundle ready for Orchard review.
- Aug 20: final deck submitted for print & AV check.

Please reply with a one-line confirmation in this format: Confirmed — slides: # — AV: yes/no — travel notes.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@orchardhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite workshop: asset grooming, presenter ownership & travel ops

Confirmed — I’ll take the exec alignment section and the high-level roadmap slides. Details: slides: 8 (including title + TL;DR), AV: no live GPU demo required for my section, travel: arrive evening 23rd; happy to pair with Karthik on the technical Q&A.

Karthik — can you own the technical deep-dive (I recommend 12–15 slides + 1 demo appendix)? Marcus — can you own run-of-show/handouts? Jeff — please confirm venue AV specs and whether we can stage a 2-minute warm-up for a GPU demo in the backline.

Thanks — I’ll upload my one-pager to the Drive by Aug 16 (earlier if possible).

Thanks Priyom — quick notes from Orchard’s side:
- Agenda looks good. For executive-facing materials please keep pricing references out until our procurement team (cc’d) has had a chance to review the commercial appendix.
- Could you include a short compliance appendix (SOC2 summary + data retention notes)? Our security lead will want that in the pre-read.
- Travel: our execs are tight on the 24th morning; would you avoid scheduling critical one-on-ones before 11:00am on the 24th?

I’ll share the final attendee roster by EOD Wed.

— Sarah

Thanks for the quick replies — consolidating actions and owners below so we have one source of truth. If an owner is out, please nominate a delegate by EOD Wed Aug 12.

Action items (owner — deliverable — due):
- Laura Bennett — exec alignment + roadmap slides (8 slides) — upload summary + deck section to Drive by Aug 16.
- Karthik Iyer — technical deep-dive (12–15 slides + demo appendix). Confirm demo duration (2–3 mins) and network port requirements by Aug 12.
- Marcus Lin — run-of-show and on-site handouts (1-pager for attendees). Confirm total printed handout count and coordinate with venue by Aug 18.
- Neha Kapoor — AV & local logistics (mics, projector, network). Run an AV test with Jeff (venue) week of Aug 20; confirm backline configuration.
- Priyom Das (me) — compile pre-read (one PDF), finalize attendee one-pager, coordinate travel block and share booking link. Pre-read to Orchard by Aug 17.

Notes from Orchard: Sarah asked to keep pricing references out of exec slides until procurement confirms and requested a compliance appendix (SOC2 summary + data retention bullet). Procurement (cc’d) — please flag any approval timeline constraints.

Links & resources:
- Master deck / upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-deck
- Draft runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-runbook
- Travel booking (internal): https://app.redwood.com/scheduler/ORCH-2026
- PO/contract signing: https://docusign.com/ORCH-2026-PO

Attachments: draft-runbook-v1.pdf, pre-read-outline.docx, venue-floorplan.png

Follow-ups: I’ll post a short checklist tomorrow with file names and the single pre-read filename convention (eg: ORCH_pre-read_v1.pdf).

Thanks everyone — please reply in-thread only if you need to reassign.
